prepare_model_for_spinquant_ptq: prepare a Llama model for SpinQuant post-training quantization by rotating weights, fusing layer norms, and configuring activation quantizers
run_weight_quantization_with_rtn: run round-to-nearest weight quantization on model layers using rtn_utils.rtn_fwrd with specified bit width and groupsize
configure_activation_quantizer_bits: configure an ActQuantizer with target bit width, groupsize, symmetry, and clipping ratio for activation quantization
apply_hadamard_rotation_to_down_proj: apply Hadamard rotation to down_proj layer weights using hadamard_utils.get_hadK for online full Hadamard transform
add_qk_rotation_wrapper_for_k_quant: add a QK rotation wrapper after RoPE to enable K-cache quantization with specified bits and groupsize
